profile.headline: Specialist, Software Engineer at Nationwide Financial

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
* Design and develop test automation using Ruby and Cucumber for a responsive web application
* Debug, refactor, and maintain automation test suite using RubyMine and Subversion
* Analyze and incorporate production level data into test suite using SQL and Active Record
* Create manual test scenarios for manual testing using HP Quality Center
* Collaborate with team members to support the application using agile practices

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
* Attended ICC Leadership Development Academy for J2EE, JDBC, Spring, and Hibernate
* Gained insight into an agile team environment through various exercises
* Attended sessions on Ruby and Cucumber along with labs and exercises
* Examined and analyzed requirements passed down from Senior Developers
